hypotheses.H0_head_decomposition_recomposes: The sum of last-layer head-specific third-order responses matches the full third-order residual with relative error <=1e-4 for every audited failure and control.
hypotheses.H1_singular_residual_is_head_localized: Across failures, the median largest absolute head projection share is at least 0.50 and median effective head support is at most 3.
hypotheses.H2_singular_residual_is_amplified: The median failure/control ratio of third-order response norm relative to exact response norm is at least 5.
hypotheses.H3_singular_residual_is_diffuse: Median effective head support exceeds 5 across failures.
